01The codesrc/routes/

Markup the compiler understands.

RSX is expanded and checked by rustc. Unclosed tags, wrong prop types and unescaped inputs fail during compilation — never in production.

  • →One file, one route
  • →HTML escaped by default (zero XSS)
  • →Zero runtime template parsing
  • →Direct memory buffer appends

02Principlessix decisions

Everything you need. Nothing that ships to the browser by accident.

Built from the ground up for teams who care about real latency, memory safety and eliminating frontend toolchain churn.

2.1

Zero hydration

HTML is written straight into a buffer and sent. Interactivity comes from tiny islands, not a 500 KB runtime.

2.2

Compile-time RSX

JSX ergonomics, verified by rustc. Typed props, auto-escaping, no template engine at runtime.

2.3

File-system routes

Drop [id].rs in src/routes. It compiles to an O(k) radix tree with instant matchit lookups.

2.4

Tailwind, managed

The standalone compiler is downloaded, watched and fingerprinted for you. No Node toolchain in sight.

2.5

Plain Axum underneath

Extractors, Tower layers, WebSockets, SSE. Yav never hides the stack — you can always reach it.

2.6

Secure defaults

CSRF tokens, HMAC-signed sessions and automatic context-aware escaping are on before you write a single line.

03Ecosystembuilt into binary

Batteries included. Zero external dependencies.

Unlike JavaScript meta-frameworks requiring dozens of disjointed npm packages, Yav provides an integrated suite directly in Rust.

07Toolchainyav CLI

One CLI for development, production & deployment.

Built in Rust with zero runtime dependencies. Replaces npm, webpack, vite, and cargo-watch in a single binary.

yav dev
Live Reload & HMR

Auto-reloads browser via WebSocket :35729, watches Tailwind CSS inputs, and displays live compile-error overlay.

yav doctor
System & Toolchain Audit

Diagnoses Rust toolchains, package.yavml health, standalone Tailwind cache, routes directory, and port bindings.

yav routes
Route Table Inspection

Inspects file-based route endpoints, HTTP methods, dynamic slugs, and active layout hierarchy in a terminal table.

yav export
Static Site Generation (SSG)

Pre-renders all static pages to HTML in dist/ with asset bundling and canonical tags for zero-server hosting.

yav build
Production Packaging

Compiles release binary, tree-shakes styles, hashes asset filenames, and pre-compresses Brotli (.br) & Gzip (.gz).

yav update
CLI & Deps Upgrades

Updates the yav CLI binary itself and upgrades project dependencies and cached Tailwind binaries seamlessly.

yav add <component>
Component Scaffolding

Instantly scaffolds UI templates: drawers, command palettes, 8 design themes, 3D tilt plates, and KPI stat cards.

yav codegen
Types & OpenAPI 3.1

Exports TypeScript type definitions and OpenAPI 3.1 specifications directly from Rust serde structs.

yav deploy
Multi-Cloud Deploy

Generates production deployment configurations for Shuttle.rs, Fly.io, Railway, Docker, and Systemd.
